title: Heart‑Healthy Cake
ingredients: Flour, Oats, Banana, Cocoa, Skim Milk
method: Mix ingredients, bake at 180°C for 25 min.

ingredients: Oats, Banana, Cocoa, Eggs, Whey Protein

method: Mix, bake 160°C 20 min, cool.
